71: L Lawliet is a world-renowned detective who takes on the challenge of catching Kira. In his investigation, L becomes suspicious of Light Yagami and makes it his goal to prove that Light is Kira.
75: The original Shinigami who dropped the Death Note in the human world, which Light Yagami ended up picking up. Acting out of pure boredom, Ryuk begins the story of Death Note on a whim.
80: Light is a third year high school student (12th Grade) at Daikoku Private Academy who also attends supplemental classes at Gamou Prep Academy in the beginning of the story. Light has a father, Soichiro Yagami, who is the head of the Police Force.
463: Mello is the older of L's two successors raised in Wammy's House, Watari's orphanage for gifted children, in Winchester, England, United Kingdom. Similar to L's fondness for sweets, Mello is often seen eating bars of chocolate.
464: Near is the younger of L's two successors raised in Wammy's House—Watari's orphanage for gifted children, in Winchester, England. Of the successors, Near is the more level-headed one, able to remain calm and calculated, while the other, Mello, is more emotional and quick to act.
835: Misa is a famous model, singer and actress and has an immense crush on Light Yagami. She usually refers to herself in the third person by calling herself "Misa-Misa" and tends to be hyperactive. She poses as the second Kira to attract the attention of the first Kira.
1904: A young man with a strong feeling for justice, and who worships Kira and refers to him as "God". He is prepared to help Kira by any means, even if it means sacrificing his own life.
1905: Rem is the Shinigami who first gives Misa her Death Note and Shinigami eyes. Similar to Ryuk, Rem possesses two Death Notes; she purposely gives a Death Note to Misa.
1906: Recognized as the most outspoken member of the investigation team, Matsuda possesses an enthusiastic yet impulsive and naïve personality, often lacking the seriousness required for his work.
1927: Souichirou Yagami is Light's father and the leader of the remains of his investigation team under L's command. He is a kind man with a strong sense of justice. He cares greatly for his family and the members of the Japanese Task Force.
1929: Namikawa is the Vice President of Sales of the Yotsuba Corporation. He initially encourages the Yotsuba Kira. He is seen as the "most talented" of the board members who has the potential to "make it to the top" without Kira.
1930: Arayoshi Hatori is one of the eight members of the Yotsuba Group.
1931: The Vice President of Rights and Planning, Kida controls the finances of the committee and contacts "Eraldo Coil." How to Read 13 describes him as "calm and collected." However he is not able to "deal with surprises," leading him to panic when "Eraldo Coil" asks for more money.
1932: A professional con-man, Aiber is hired by L for his skills. He was proven helpful in playing the role of Eraldo Coil in the Yotsuba Arc, and in coaching Misa for her interview with the Yotsuba group. He died from liver cancer on 7 April, 2005.
1933: Wedy, real name Mary Kenwood, is a professional burglar in the employ of L. She installs bugs in the Yotsuba Group's meeting room to secretly observe the group's weekly meetings.
2179: Watari is L's assistant, providing logistics to the investigation team. Before the team is formed, he is the only person who has seen L, and the only one capable of contacting L directly. Like L, he represents himself with an Old English "W" on computer screens.
2402: Shidoh is a Shinigami whose Death Note is stolen by Ryuk. In fact, Ryuk takes his Note and gives it to Light, which becomes Higuchi's note and is finally passed on to Mello's gang (more specifically, Mello's subordinate, Kal Snyder (also known as Jack Neylon)).
2730: Matt is a cohort of Mello's. He does some espionage work for him and is an accomplice in Takada's kidnapping. He follows orders without question, usually smoking a cigarette as he does. Not much else is known about him, other than he is a former resident of Wammy's orphanage.
3765: Kiyomi Takada is the former college classmate and girlfriend of Light Yagami who later becomes Kira's spokeswoman on the NHN television station.
3766: One of the most dedicated members of the investigation team. Little else is known of him. He remains mostly silent.
3767: Aizawa is an intelligent, respected member of both the NPA and Task Force. He takes his work very seriously and chooses to work strictly within the law.
3769: Halle Lidner, real name Halle Bullook, works for Near as part of his investigation team, along with Gevanni and Rester. She is mentioned to be a former CIA agent.
3770: Stephen works for Near as part of his investigation team, along with Lidner and Rester, and later plays an important role in stopping Kira.
3883: Jealous only appears in a flashback when Rem explains a method to kill a Shinigami. In this flashback, Rem recalls Jealous watching over a woman in the human world.
4959: Naomi is a former "first rate" FBI agent who is engaged to Raye Penber. She is very intelligent, however she often lets her feelings get in the way of her investigative abilities.
5174: Shingo Midou is one of the eight members of the Yotsuba Group.
7044: Raye Penber is an American Investigator from the FBI, who was sent to Japan along with 11 other FBI agents to track down Kira. Raye was assigned to investigate the Yagami family for any suspicious behavior; specifically focusing on Light Yagami.
17555: Hirokazu Ukita is the most emotional of the Kira investigation team that is lead by L.
20002: Hideki Ide is one of the few police officers who remains with Souichirou Yagami during the Kira Investigation. However, he swiftly leaves when begins to disagree with L's methods of investigation.
23514: Anthony Lester is the Captain of a special force squad, and is now the SPK's number 2 and its operation leader. He can be seen as Near's guardian and personal assistant, similarly to what Watari was to L.
30939: Hitoshi Demegawa is a publicity hound and the director of Sakura TV.
30944: Lind L. Tailor is a convicted criminal sentenced to die. L places Tailor as a decoy on television in order to lure out Kira. Light, in a foolish rage, ends up killing Tailor with a heart attack, believing him to be "L" even though he is not.
36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
37996: He s the leader of the Mafia organization that Mello joins after leaving Wammy's House.
46237: Takuo Shibuimaru is the second person that Light kills using his Death Note. Shibuimaru rides a motorcycle and travels with a group of bikers, and starts annoying a woman in the street.
53663: Yuri is a young girl that has a crush on Light Yagami. Light decides to invite her on a date to Space Land. He asks her out as part of his plan to help find out Raye Penber's name, so that he can write it in the Death Note.
79469: Guuk is one of the thirteen shinigami, he has what looks to be a rams skull for is head and fair patches around his body. His shingami rank is seven and he is often seen gambling with other shingami in the shingami realm.
84503: He is the Head of Personnel in the Yotsuba Corporation. He is a very paranoid person, and always keeps a close eye on others. Shimura's ability to pay attention to small details allowed him to join the Yotsuba Group meetings. He does not like his predicament whatsoever.
84505: He is the Vice President of Yotsuba Material Planning Division and Yotsuba Homes. He's never had what it takes to be a true leader and was selected to attend the meetings to make Higuchi look good.
84507: He is the Yotsuba Vice President of VT Enterprises. He works with the Yotsuba Group as the eldest and "most influential" member and he appears to control the conferences. He individually contacts the members of the committee.
84513: He is a drug addict and a criminal used by Light to trick Raye Penber into revealing his FBI badge to Light so he can kill him.
84517: McEnroe is an SPK member and FBI officer. He is sent to the Japanese National Police Agency HQ in order to request that the Death Note that they have is handed over to the United States government, and thus the SPK.
84527: She is the daughter of Shuichi Aizawa and Eriko Aizawa.
84531: She is the wife of Shuichi Aizawa and mother of Yumi Aizawa and a baby son. She and her children are usually sad because Aizawa is overworked and unable to spend time with them.
144332: Roger is the manager of the “Wammy’s House” whenever Watari is not present.
